name: Chronicles of a Dark Lord: Episode 1 Tides of Fate - Nightmare Vision
summary: Delve into the mind of Magus Drakhen Lee as he becomes trapped within his own fragmented dreams. The Tides of Fate DLC updates much of the games graphics and textures, updates maps and adds enemies exclusive to the DLC.
